memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- GERD
  - Status: New diagnosis, heartburn 3-4 days/week, sour regurgitation after meals, no alarm symptoms.
  - Plan: Start pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, domperidone 10 mg BD before meals, antacid gel SOS. Advise small frequent meals, avoid coffee, spicy food, late-night eating. Record weight 58 kg, waist 78 cm (below female cut‑off 80 cm). Diet advice: Breakfast – idli with chutney, no chili; Lunch – rice, dal, steamed veg; Dinner – roti, curd, avoid fried.
- Due: Next HbA1c due 2025-07-05 (routine check).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- GERD
  - Status: Slight worsening, heartburn 2-3 days/week after dinner, mild bloating.
  - Plan: Increase pantoprazole to 40 mg BD (breakfast and dinner), continue antacid gel SOS. Advise dinner before 8 pm, elevate head of bed. Weight 57.2 kg, waist 76 cm (<80 cm). Diet advice: Breakfast – vegetable uttapam; Lunch – brown rice, dal, beetroot salad; Dinner – khichdi, steamed veg, avoid fried.
- Due: Next HbA1c due 2026-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Upper GI endoscopy: No erosions, normal mucosa, no hiatal hernia. Biopsy negative for H. pylori, Candida, or dysplasia.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Gastroenterology review: Endoscopy findings consistent with mild GERD. Recommend continuation of PPI twice daily, lifestyle modifications, and follow-up in 3 months. No surgical intervention indicated.
